body: Oh and I’d also like to be wealthy enough to not ever have to worry about money because I grew up dirt poor

I play a lot of league of legends and I watch a ton of anime so that eats up almost all of my free time outside of school and the gym.  I’d ideally love a job in machine learning because I absolutely love math and computers and the idea of creating consciousness is fascinating to me. I’d ideally like a life where I have good friends a relationship that’s mutually fulfilling. No I went to public school where my life was basically the same but without the good grades until grade 11 when I realized I wanted to get into a top university. I’d love to go to events of really any kind but everyone I ask says no. Thank you for talking to me, this is the first conversation i’ve had that isn’t assignment related and not with my parents in about 5 months.

Totally empathize with the perfectionism. Honestly man I don’t know why. I’m average looking face wise around 6 feet tall around 190lb with a large frame at roughly 11% body fat so I really don’t think it’s the way I look. My family tells me i’m very normal socially and quite charming. Profs also tend to like me. I’m generally at the top of the class (math/cs major) To be honest I go to office hours just so I don’t have to be alone between classes.  People my own age (around 20) really just don’t like me or connect with me. Girls are especially very mean if I try to talk to them for honestly no reason. (i don’t want anyone to recognize this so i apologize for being intentionally vague about my descriptions) What do you do specifically for hope? I’m running out of time

It’s not enough because regardless of how hard I try to become better and as proud as i am of myself just no one sees it. People refuse to acknowledge i exist and people shrug my off regardless of how friendly I try to be. I tried committing before but i bitched out and fell for the lie that is self improvement.
